cohort: 12 pregnant women diagnosed with COVID-19 by positive RT-PCR who delivered at Koru Hospital (Ankara, Turkey) between March 2020 and February 2021
finding: Maternal and neonatal outcomes were good in pregnant women with COVID-19 and vertical transmission seems unlikely
mod_finding: All deliveries in pregnant women with COVID-19 were by cesarean section.
gest_age: Mean gestational age at diagnosis of COVID-19 34 weeks (range 22 to 39 weeks 6 days), mean gestational age at delivery 38 weeks 4 days (range 35 to 40 weeks)
